'''Tanik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]]. On [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he sold mods in the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]] to [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forces.
